items.title: Zcash gets first European ETP following US ETF launch
items.summary: 21shares listed physically backed ZEC and ETHFI products on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam, as issuers broaden their offerings beyond major cryptocurrencies.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Take Nearly $1B in a Day as Average Holder Returns to Profit
items.summary: The funds pulled in more on Monday than across the whole of last week, when they posted the weakest net inflow of their history.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attract nearly $1 billion in largest daily inflow in 11 months
items.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $999 million in net inflows on Monday, the largest single-day amount the funds have attracted since Oct.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted nearly $1 billion on Monday, the 9th largest inflow ever
items.summary: Inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs picked up Monday as bitcoin rallied to its highest since January.
